scope: Two hundred twelve statements. The thirty-seven on time reversal, the ripple factors and the wall at the 0,0 split; the one hundred four on prime ticks counted ahead and back, the paired buckets, the bucket rule and starts; and twenty-four that join them: a meter from 0 to 5/5 with fills and empties, two windows taking turns, two full meters meeting at 0,0 into one full bucket, rounds without end, the guards gAB and gBA from FullModel.lean as meter levels that keep the wall between 1/50 and 1/10, contact through the guards, reversal on both guards together, reversal on a bucket or start of any number of parts, every prime tick counted back at the reversed time, 0 holding the past and the future together, and one count through 0; and fifteen on the write, the remainder, the filter loop and the freeze: bucket gain plus remainder is the whole overlap, the bucket stays between 0 and 5/5 through any number of passes, a filter with a fixed share leaves that share's complement to the power n times the start and settles, and the loop run backward has the same totals; the first write at tick 11 (time 0.4) and the freeze following it at tick 23 (time 0.8), whose 1/5 and 4/5 shares have the same values as A's let-go and keep; and the first write at tick 11 (time 0.4) followed by the freeze at tick 23 (time 0.8), whose balance closes the gap in the proportions keep 4/5 and loss 1/5; and five on a discrete Poincaré–Wirtinger inequality on a path: for mean-zero data 2 ∑ f² ≤ n(n−1) times the Dirichlet energy, and the mean has no gap; and fifteen on the sharp discrete Wirtinger inequality on a cycle ZMod n, (2 − 2cos(2π/n)) ∑ f² ≤ ∑ (f(j+1) − f j)² for mean-zero f, attained by a cosine for n ≥ 3; and twelve on a Poincaré inequality on the discrete 3-torus ZMod a × ZMod b × ZMod c: for f with sum zero, min_i (2 − 2cos(2π/n_i)) ∑ f² ≤ the sum of squared forward differences in the three directions, attained by a cosine along the longest side, the mean has no gap, and N²(2 − 2cos(2π/N)) ≤ (2π)² with limit (2π)².
